baseline.finding: Original driver directly calls SDK ConnectPort/MotionCtrl/JointCtrl. No _configure_command_transport and no current command failure latch.

confirmed_change.code: _configure_command_transport: bounded bus.send(timeout=0.005), followed by checked_send on transport.SendCanMessage enum return. Non-success becomes RuntimeError; watchdog/joint exception handling calls _stop_commands and latches further command acceptance.
confirmed_change.mechanism: Installed SDK SendCanMessage catches all bus.send exceptions and returns a failure enum. The outer checked_send makes this previously SDK-reported failure propagate to driver stop handling.
